payload.natural_language_statement:
Let $n\ge1$ and $0=t_0<t_1<\cdots<t_n$. For $0\le i<n$, let $r_i:[t_i,t_{i+1}]\to\mathbb R$ be continuous. Write
$$D_+r_i(t)=\liminf_{s\to t^+}\frac{r_i(s)-r_i(t)}{s-t}.$$
Assume $r_0(0)\ge-6$, and, for each $i<n$ and $t_i\le t<t_{i+1}$,
$$D_+r_i(t)\ge\frac23r_i(t)^2.$$
At every internal joining time, assume $r_i(t_{i+1})\le r_{i+1}(t_{i+1})$ for $i+1<n$. Then
$$r_i(t)\ge-\frac6{1+4t}\qquad(0\le i<n,\ t_i\le t\le t_{i+1}).$$
This isolates the scalar comparison step used in Kleiner-Lott's surgery estimates, with upward jumps allowed. Applying it to scalar-curvature minima requires establishing these analytic hypotheses from the geometry; this statement does not itself formalize a Ricci flow.

[Source: Kleiner-Lott, proof of Lemma 79.11, p. 154](https://arxiv.org/pdf/math/0605667v5#page=154), using [Appendix B, equations (B.1)-(B.2), p. 202](https://arxiv.org/pdf/math/0605667v5#page=202).
